typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Medical Record Number} as string,
		Region as string,
		{Subscriber Contact ID} as string,
		Event as string,
		{Event Date} as string,
		{Event Source} as string,
		{Eligibility Effective Date} as string,
		Salutation as string,
		{First Name} as string,
		{Middle Name} as string,
		{Last Name} as string,
		Suffix as string,
		Gender as string,
		Birthdate as string,
		{Work Phone} as string,
		{Home Phone} as string,
		{Mobile Phone } as string,
		Email as string,
		Deceased as string,
		{Enrollment Date} as string,
		{Contact Status} as string,
		{Terminated Member Indicator} as string,
		Role as string,
		{Do Not Mail} as string,
		{Do Not Call} as string,
		{Email Opt Out} as string,
		{Do Not Contact} as string,
		Married as string,
		Ethnicity as string,
		{Bad Phone Indicator} as string,
		{Preferred Spoken Language} as string,
		{Primary Care Physician} as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/KPWA_Members*']) ~> source1
source(output(
		RecordTypeId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/kpwa_members_record_type_id.csv']) ~> RecordTypeId
Select1, RecordTypeId join(1 == 1,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'right')~> Join1
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Medical_record_number__c = {Medical Record Number},
		Region__c = Region,
		Subscriber_contact_id__c = {Subscriber Contact ID},
		Event__c = Event,
		Event_Date__c = {Event Date},
		Event_Source__c = {Event Source},
		Eligibility_Effective_Date__c = {Eligibility Effective Date},
		Salutation__c = Salutation,
		First_Name__c = {First Name},
		Middle_Name__c = {Middle Name},
		Last_Name__c = {Last Name},
		Suffix__c = Suffix,
		Gender__c = Gender,
		Birthdate__c,
		Work_Phone__c = {Work Phone},
		Home_Phone__c = {Home Phone},
		Mobile_Phone__c = {Mobile Phone },
		Email__c = Email,
		Deceased__c = Deceased,
		Enrollment_Date__c = {Enrollment Date},
		Contact_Status__c = {Contact Status},
		Terminated_Member_Indicator__c = {Terminated Member Indicator},
		Role__c = Role,
		Do_Not_Mail__c = {Do Not Mail},
		Do_Not_Call__c = {Do Not Call},
		HasOptedOutOfEmail__c,
		Do_Not_Contact__c = {Do Not Contact},
		Married__c = Married,
		Ethnicity__c = Ethnicity,
		Bad_Phone_Indicator__c = {Bad Phone Indicator},
		Preferred_Spoken_Language__c = {Preferred Spoken Language},
		Primary_Care_Physician__c = {Primary Care Physician}
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit1@toInsert derive(Birthdate__c = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(Birthdate, 'yyyyMMdd')), Birthdate),
		Gender__c = iif(Gender=="M","Male","Female"),
		HasOptedOutOfEmail__c = iif(upper({Email Opt Out})=='Y','true','false'),
		Eligibility_Effective_Date__c = coalesce(toString(toDate({Eligibility Effective Date}, 'yyyyMMdd')), {Eligibility Effective Date}),
		Enrollment_Date__c = coalesce(toString(toDate({Enrollment Date}, 'yyyyMMdd')), {Enrollment Date}),
		Event_Date__c = coalesce(toString(toDate({Event Date}, 'yyyyMMdd')), {Event Date}),
		Bad_Phone_Indicator__c = iif(upper({Bad Phone Indicator})=='Y','true','false'),
		Do_Not_Call__c = iif(upper({Do Not Call})=='Y','true','false'),
		Do_Not_Contact__c = iif(upper({Do Not Contact})=='Y','true','false'),
		Do_Not_Mail__c = iif(upper({Do Not Mail})=='Y','true','false'),
		Married__c = iif(upper(Married)=='Y','true','false')) ~> DerivedColumn1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> AddADFId
AddADFId split(isNull({Medical Record Number})||isNull({Subscriber Contact ID})||isNull({Eligibility Effective Date})||isNull({First Name})||isNull({Last Name})||isNull(Gender)||isNull(Birthdate)||isNull({Home Phone})||isNull({Contact Status})||isNull(Role),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(toReject, toInsert)
ConditionalSplit1@toReject derive(REJECT_REASON = iif(isNull({Medical Record Number})||isNull({Subscriber Contact ID})||isNull({Eligibility Effective Date})||isNull({First Name})||isNull({Last Name})||isNull(Gender)||isNull(Birthdate)||isNull({Home Phone})||isNull({Contact Status})||isNull(Role), 
concat('ADF:Field contain NULL value: ', iif(isNull({Medical Record Number}), '{MEDICAL RECORD NUMBER} ', ''),iif(isNull({Subscriber Contact ID}), '{SUBSCRIBER CONTACT ID} ', ''),iif(isNull({Eligibility Effective Date}), '{ELIGIBILITY EFFECTIVE DATE} ', ''),iif(isNull({First Name}), '{FIRST NAME} ', ''),iif(isNull({Last Name}), '{LAST NAME} ', ''),iif(isNull(Gender), 'GENDER ', ''),iif(isNull(Birthdate), 'BIRTHDATE ', ''),iif(isNull({Home Phone}), '{HOME PHONE} ', ''),iif(isNull({Contact Status}), '{CONTACT STATUS} ', ''),iif(isNull(Role), 'ROLE ', '')), '')) ~> rejectResaon
rejectResaon select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Join1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['KPWA_Members_Staging_Inbound_Campaign__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insert
AddADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['KPWA_Members_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedRaw
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['KPWA_Members_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toReject
